Quest main 06: Start (1)

  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_main_07.end.07.oggHeard in the sound file No. It told me to try the abilities out for real. I did. That's it.

  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_main_07.step_02.02.oggHeard in the sound file Just no fanaticism. I don't want to learn the cost of a mistake the hard way.

  • Nathan ColeSad→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_personal_sera_03.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file We tell the truth straight. Whoever stays by our side after that will stay for real.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_personal_sera_03.choice.pragmatic.oggHeard in the sound file We reveal only what will help people survive. The rest shouldn't break the team before the fight.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_personal_sera_03.choice.02.oggHeard in the sound file I'll tell the truth and won't hide behind an order. If questions remain afterwards, I'll answer them myself.
Quest personal sera 03: Cutscene (1)
  • Nathan ColeAngry→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_personal_sera_03.observer.04.oggHeard in the sound file Let her go.
Quest personal sera 03: End (1)
  • Nathan Cole→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_personal_sera_03.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Then we hold our course and answer for the consequences.
Quest personal sera 03: Start (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_personal_sera_03.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file I'll hear you out to the end, and I won't make the choice out of fear.
Quest side mvp 01 kill zombies: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Systemquest_side_mvp_01_kill_zombies.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file The passage is clear. We need to get the groups out before they come back.
Quest side mvp 01 kill zombies: Start (2)
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_01_kill_zombies.start.choice.fast.oggHeard in the sound file I'll clear it fast. Before the pack gathers more tightly, the corridor can be opened with little blood.
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_01_kill_zombies.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Copy. I'll take down the pack and open a safe corridor for people.
Quest side mvp 02 collect resources: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeHappy→Systemquest_side_mvp_02_collect_resources.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file The supplies are in the bunker. That'll give us one more day.
Quest side mvp 02 collect resources: Start (2)
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_02_collect_resources.start.choice.priority.oggHeard in the sound file Scrap metal first. Without it, repairs stall. I'll leave anything extra if it slows the retreat.
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_02_collect_resources.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Alright, I'll gather everything that can still be carried and be back before dark.
Quest side mvp 03 defense waves: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeHappy→Systemquest_side_mvp_03_defense_waves.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file We fought them off. People need to breathe, and the next shift needs to get ready.
Quest side mvp 03 defense waves: Start (2)
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_03_defense_waves.start.choice.line.oggHeard in the sound file I hold the line and don't chase stragglers. The line matters more than pretty statistics.
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_03_defense_waves.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Copy. We hold the line and don't let them near the shelter.
Quest side mvp 04 reach level: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeHappy→Systemquest_side_mvp_04_reach_level.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Good, now we're not a panicking crowd, but a team.
Quest side mvp 04 reach level: Start (2)
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_04_reach_level.start.choice.discipline.oggHeard in the sound file We train formation and basic reactions. The team should move like a team.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Systemquest_side_mvp_04_reach_level.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Deal. We'll run the drills and get people back in shape.
Quest side mvp 05 destroy object: End (1)
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_05_destroy_object.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file The node is dust. The bunker should get on the air while the window is open.
Quest side mvp 05 destroy object: Start (2)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Systemquest_side_mvp_05_destroy_object.start.choice.silent.oggHeard in the sound file I'll approach quietly and take the note out without noise. The best sabotage is the one noticed late.
  • Nathan ColeAngry→Systemquest_side_mvp_05_destroy_object.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Enough putting up with this jammer. I'm going to break the node before it breaks us.
Quest side mvp 06 kill boss: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Systemquest_side_mvp_06_kill_boss.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file One alpha down, but a new one will take its place soon, so let's not slow down.
Quest side mvp 06 kill boss: Start (2)
  • Nathan ColeAngry→Systemquest_side_mvp_06_kill_boss.start.choice.burst.oggHeard in the sound file I take the target down fast. The shorter the fight, the less chance it has to call the pack.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Systemquest_side_mvp_06_kill_boss.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Copy. First I'll find Karkan, then choose a place for the fight where his pack won't pin us against the water.
Quest side mvp 07 signal relay: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeHappy→Systemquest_side_mvp_07_signal_relay.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file The link is holding. We need to reach our people before the airwaves choke.
Quest side mvp 07 signal relay: Start (2)
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_07_signal_relay.start.choice.priority.oggHeard in the sound file The highest node first. If it comes back to life, the rest will be easier to find.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Systemquest_side_mvp_07_signal_relay.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Copy. If we restore communications, people will have a chance to call for help again.
Quest side mvp 08 medicine run: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeHappy→Systemquest_side_mvp_08_medicine_run.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file The Medkits are here. For the first time in a long while, we're healing, not just counting losses.
Quest side mvp 08 medicine run: Start (2)
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_08_medicine_run.start.choice.kits.oggHeard in the sound file First aid kits and supplies first. Anything that doesn't save lives can wait for the next raid.
  • Nathan Cole→Systemquest_side_mvp_08_medicine_run.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Copy. I'm going to the supermarket. I'll check the pharmacy sections and come back with what will keep people on their feet.
Quest side mvp 09a civilians first: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Good. Now, we hold out this night. And tomorrow, we'll have to look in the eyes of those who go out with almost no ammo.
Quest side mvp 09a civilians first: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file Civilians First If the aid station is empty, we've already lost the very reason we're holding up the walls.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We take the medicine, but keep an escape route and a reserve for the shooters. Panic won't help us either.
  • Nathan Cole→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.start.choice.pragmatic.oggHeard in the sound file If these drugs get people back in action faster, we take them. Compassion has to work too.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file I hear you. Then we go for the medicine. But I know the price. On the next outing, our shooters will be counting every round.
Quest side mvp 09b defense first: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Yes, we held the walls, but someone paid for it with pain inside them. Decisions like that don't let go.
Quest side mvp 09b defense first: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file I'll choose defense, but don't call those left without medicine an acceptable loss.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We take the ammo, but we don't strip everything bare. The aid station needs a chance too. We need order, not a new crack in the team.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file We're holding the perimeter. If the walls collapse, the aid station will simply become another room for corpses.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Got it. We'll take the ammo and hold the line. But that means the aid station will have to choose who gets treated first again.
Quest side mvp 10a refugee convoy: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Good, but now the perimeter is thinner. No kind choice comes without a debt.
Quest side mvp 10a refugee convoy: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file We lead the column. If we stop opening doors to the living, the bunker becomes just a concrete grave.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We get them out, but split the route into groups. One mistake, and we lead the waves straight to the gates.
  • Nathan Cole→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.start.choice.pragmatic.oggHeard in the sound file If there are working hands and knowledge among them, the risk will pay off. We get them out, but count the load on the bunker.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Alright, we lead the people. But after this, the defenses will sag, and everyone will have to get through the night on edge.
Quest side mvp 10b power grid: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Yes, we chose the survival of the majority, but that doesn't make the choice clean. It just makes it ours.
Quest side mvp 10b power grid: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file I'll switch on the grid, but don't pretend the people by the road have become less alive than the people behind the wall.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We power the defenses, but leave a group watching the column. Total blindness there will hit us too.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file We bring the grid up. Without light, doors and turrets, we're not a shelter, we're a feeding trough.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Then I'll bring the substations back up, and remember, this choice will come back to us.
Quest side mvp 11a prisoner exchange: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Yes, but it's not over. We bought lives now, and a debt for later.
Quest side mvp 11a prisoner exchange: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file We make the exchange. Living people matter more than a pretty victory over someone already in our hands.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We'll exchange, but with markers, surveillance, and a backup retreat. Mercy without insurance quickly becomes a trap.
  • Nathan Cole→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.start.choice.pragmatic.oggHeard in the sound file If one prisoner buys us several living people today, that's a deal worth taking.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file All right, we make the exchange, but I'll remember his face. Next time, he may come back with fire.
Quest side mvp 11b zero mercy: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Yes, we held the walls, but part of us stayed on the other side of those walls.
Quest side mvp 11b zero mercy: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file I won't give up our people, but I don't want to build safety on something we'll later have to hide from the children.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We'll answer with force, but without a showcase slaughter. Fear only works as long as we haven't become worse than the threat.
  • Nathan ColeAngry→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file We hit hard and fast. If they hunt our people, let them be afraid to come near the doors.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Decided. We go hard. Just don't try to call it an easy decision.
Quest side mvp 12a school evac: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Today, we chose life. Tomorrow, we'll pay for that choice with time and blood.
Quest side mvp 12a school evac: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file We go for the children. If we start treating them as a secondary objective, the bunker has already lost.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We get them out in small groups and clear the corridor in advance. The rescue mustn't turn into a stampede.
  • Nathan Cole→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.start.choice.pragmatic.oggHeard in the sound file If we get the children out, the adults in the bunker will believe again that all this isn't for nothing. That's a resource, too.

Quest side mvp 12b armory guard: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file The choice was dirty, and now we have to live with it.
Quest side mvp 12b armory guard: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file I'll lock down the depot, but don't call the school sentimentality. There are people there, not a lying in a report.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We reinforce the depot, but don't burn through all the reserves. Weapons matter, but an empty flank won't save them.
  • Nathan Cole→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file We lock down the armory. Without weapons, the next assault will end not in an argument, but in a list of the dead.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Decided. We lock down the depot and hold the perimeter. We're not crossing the school out. It'll just have to wait.
Quest side mvp 13a truth archive: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→David Kimquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Then we hold our course. Today is hard, but tomorrow, at least we'll know whom to look for.
Quest side mvp 13a truth archive: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→David Kimquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file I'll get the records, but I don't want hungry people to feel forgotten because of them.
  • Nathan ColeSad→David Kimquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file I'm going for the logs. If they show who directed the raids, we have no right to look away.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→David Kimquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.start.choice.principle.oggHeard in the sound file We need the truth, not for an argument. If we don't keep a record of who profited from those first hours and how, we'll be deceived again.
  • Nathan Cole→David Kimquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Alright, I'm going for the logs. Truth is a resource, too. You just can't see it in the rations.
Quest side mvp 13b food priority: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file We chose life today. That means tomorrow, we'll have a chance to hold them accountable for everything.
Quest side mvp 13b food priority: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We take the food, but leave markers for the archive. If the trail goes completely cold, we'll regret it later.
  • Nathan Cole→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file Food first. A hungry team doesn't hold formation and doesn't search for the truth.
  • Nathan ColeHappy→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.start.choice.humor.oggHeard in the sound file Cans first. They say conspiracies never get solved on an empty stomach anyway.
  • Nathan Cole→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Copy. Food and order first. We'll get to the truth if we survive this night.
Quest side mvp 14a open truth: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Maya Chenquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Better a painful truth than a convenient lie before a new strike.
Quest side mvp 14a open truth: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Maya Chenquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.start.choice.open.oggHeard in the sound file I'll go out to the people and say it without pretty packaging. Better they hear a tremor in my voice than a new lie.
  • Nathan Cole→Maya Chenquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.start.choice.pragmatic.oggHeard in the sound file We tell the truth ourselves before rumors do it for us. We control the blow instead of putting out the fire later.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Maya Chenquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.start.choice.principle.oggHeard in the sound file The truth belongs to everyone. Hiding it from the bunker means deciding for people as if they were children.
  • Nathan ColeSad→Maya Chenquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Alright, we tell the truth, even if it hurts.
Quest side mvp 14b quiet order: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file We won the night. Tomorrow, we'll have to pay for this silence.
Quest side mvp 14b quiet order: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file I'll keep the panic down, but people there have lost family. They need at least a drop of truth, not just orders.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We'll say the minimum, but keep a record of what we hid, and Untracked Lie will later explode harder than the truth.
  • Nathan Cole→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file We dose the information. Right now, we need the ranks together, not a collective nervous breakdown.
  • Nathan Cole→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Copy. First we keep people in order. Then we'll deal with the truth.
Quest side mvp 15a family evac: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeHappy→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Today, we saved the very people we hold this bunker for.
Quest side mvp 15a family evac: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file We go for the families. If the bunker can't open its door to children, it's already empty inside.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We'll get them out, but recon goes first. The rescue mustn't lead the waves straight to the bunker.
  • Nathan Cole→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.start.choice.pragmatic.oggHeard in the sound file If we get the families out, the people in the bunker will understand again why they hold the walls. It'll pay off in morale.
  • Nathan Cole→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file We go for the people. Let it cost us pace, but not our humanity.
Quest side mvp 15b hunt organizer: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Yes, at least now there's less chance it'll happen again tomorrow.
Quest side mvp 15b hunt organizer: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.start.choice.care.oggHeard in the sound file I'll go after him, but the families in the block mustn't become a price that's convenient not to see.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We go after him, but no blind chase. If it's bait, we won't hand him half the squad.
  • Nathan ColeAngry→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file We hit his gang. As long as he has fighters, any families we save will become targets again.
  • Nathan ColeAngry→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Copy. We cut off the head of the chain while it's within striking distance.
Quest side mvp 16a rescue engineers: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeHappy→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Excellent. So, our chances for tomorrow have become a bit more honest.
Quest side mvp 16a rescue engineers: Start (4)
  • Nathan Cole→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file I'm going into the Metro to pull the group out. Then they can explain themselves how to keep the lights from dying.
  • Nathan Cole→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.start.choice.pragmatic.oggHeard in the sound file We get the engineers out. One person with the power circuit layout is worth a whole warehouse of hardware right now.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.start.choice.principle.oggHeard in the sound file We won't abandon people just because silent victims are more convenient for the reactor.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file We get them out. Without people who know the system, we've already lost.
Quest side mvp 16b secure reactor: End (1)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file We held the bunker. Now we have to survive the price of that order.
Quest side mvp 16b secure reactor: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.start.choice.caution.oggHeard in the sound file We stabilize the circuit step-by-step. Measurement, cutoff, reserve. The reactor doesn't forgive flashy moves.
  • Nathan ColeHappy→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.start.choice.dare.oggHeard in the sound file We run the circuit hot and win the night. If it holds, we can argue about protocols later.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.start.choice.direct.oggHeard in the sound file We close the emergency circuit now. If the lights go out, all other decisions become theory.
  • Nathan ColeSad→Oliver Stormquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file Copy. We stabilize the reactor, even if we'll come to hate this decision later.

  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Natalie Brooksquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.ethics.02.oggHeard in the sound file I'll go in, but the right to stop the test will be yours, not Liang's and not the system's.

  • Nathan ColeSad→Emily Riversquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.aftermath.02.oggHeard in the sound file I'll talk to them, without promising miracles. I'll just tell the truth and ask them to stick together while we still can.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Sun Wei "Doc" Liangquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file But something remained. I remember a movement I never learned. Record that separately from the report to the system.
Quest side mvp 17a test serum: Start (4)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Sun Wei "Doc" Liangquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.start.choice.people.oggHeard in the sound file If I start forgetting names or speaking someone else's words, pull me out immediately. Data later.
  • Nathan Cole→Sun Wei "Doc" Liangquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.start.choice.protocol.oggHeard in the sound file We tested on me. Two short cycles. A log of every reaction. Emergency shutdown in Natalie's hands.
  • Nathan Cole→Sun Wei "Doc" Liangquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.start.choice.risk.oggHeard in the sound file I'm going into the circuit. No safety pauses. Run the full cycle straight away. If the rule holds, I want to know how much it can take.
  • Nathan ColeDoubt→Sun Wei "Doc" Liangquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.start.02.oggHeard in the sound file The system proposed someone else, so we'll check how much it needs the result when I'm the one taking the risk.
Quest side mvp 17b destroy serum: Choice (1)
  • Nathan ColeSad→Natalie Brooksquest_side_mvp_17b_destroy_serum.ethics.02.oggHeard in the sound file Then we cut to the quick, but without blood. We remove the risk now and look for another chance later.

Story dialogue (125)

Quest ending acceptance: End (1)
  • Emily RiversSad→Nathan Colequest_ending_acceptance.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The Nora talking to you now won't bring your daughter back. You know that. Can you let go of the past and let her be herself?
Quest ending acceptance: Start (1)
  • Emily RiversSad→Nathan Colequest_ending_acceptance.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file We need to talk about Nora, not the one you're looking for, the one who exists now. I'll help you separate the memory from her, but whether you're ready to let go is your decision.
Quest ending consent: Start (1)
  • Emily Rivers→Nathan Colequest_ending_consent.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file The link to her is ready. Tell her everything as it is. One core, no copies, nothing beyond this world. Then, just listen to her. It's her choice.
Quest main 02: Start (1)
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_02.step_02.01.oggHeard in the sound file The containers are intact. A separate protocol for these samples has appeared in the laboratory. Choose it. The other research won't help us right now.
Quest main 05: End (1)
  • Emily RiversHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_05.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file At least you have some protection now. Still, don't let your guard down, okay?
Quest main 05: Start (2)
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_05.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file You have almost no protection. Set up the workshops, make weapons and armor. I feel calmer when there's at least something between you and their teeth.
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_05.step_02.01.oggHeard in the sound file The workshop is ready. Make a reliable weapon. I know how to heal, but it's better to do without that.
Quest main 06: End (2)
  • Emily Rivers→Nathan Colequest_main_06.end.park.oggHeard in the sound file Enough blood for today. Seeds instead. The old records put them in the park greenhouse. I've marked it on the map. There's a radio signal nearby too. Check it while you're there.
  • Emily RiversHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_06.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file You're back. Let me take a look. The raid was stopped. We can breathe out. At least for a little while.
Quest main 06: Start (2)
  • Emily RiversAfraid→Nathan Colequest_main_06.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file I caught their chatter on the radio. The bandits notice the generator and want to take it, along with our supplies. Their leader is gathering people by the warehouses. If we wait, they'll come right to our door.
  • Emily RiversAfraid→Nathan Colequest_main_06.step_02.01.oggHeard in the sound file They call in reinforcements through two alarm transmitters. Switch them off and the fight will be easier. But if you decide to go straight for the leader, stay away from getting surrounded.
Quest main 07: End (12)
  • Emily RiversSad→Nathan Colequest_main_07.system.01.oggHeard in the sound file I understand. If we don't do anything about them, we might regret it later.
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_07.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Some kind of interface popped up for me too. It says something about them. I just can't tell what yet.
  • Emily RiversHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_07.survivors.02.oggHeard in the sound file We'll deal with the bandits, too. But first, let's help those who need it most.
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_07.end.06.oggHeard in the sound file Did it give you the next task? Maybe that will clear something up.
  • Emily RiversSurprised→Nathan Colequest_main_07.end.08.oggHeard in the sound file There's something else. I went through the notes and trophies from the camp. There's not only supplies there, there are traces of other people.
  • Emily Rivers→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_07.end.10.oggHeard in the sound file Let's look for other survivors. You held out in the park on your own, Marcos. So there could be others. I'd start there.
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_07.end.12.oggHeard in the sound file But your brain wasn't washed. Maybe you're not the only one?
  • Emily RiversSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_07.end.14.oggHeard in the sound file If they strike at night, the generator will be their first target, and the infirmary right after it.
  • Emily RiversSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_07.end.16.oggHeard in the sound file But it's the same with the survivors. If we delay, there may be no one left to find.
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_07.end.18.oggHeard in the sound file I think the bandits can wait a day or two. Nothing will happen. But for the survivors, those days could be their last. I'd start with them.
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_07.end.20.oggHeard in the sound file So are yours. Nathan, what do you say?
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_07.end.22.oggHeard in the sound file I won't be offended if you decide to deal with the bandits first. But I'm worried about the survivors. It's right that you're the one to choose.
Quest main 07: Start (2)
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_07.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Nathan, willpower alone won't carry us any further. This interface in my head scares me, but it's also a chance. We have to learn to use it, or we'll be crushed.
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_07.step_02.01.oggHeard in the sound file It sounds insane, but if the world now runs on rules, let's learn to use them.
Quest main 08b: Choice (1)
  • Emily RiversAfraid→Nathan Colequest_main_08b.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file The direct way. We'll get there sooner, but it's more dangerous. The detour. Longer, but a better chance of coming back. I'm... afraid of getting it wrong.
Quest main 08b: End (1)
  • Emily RiversSad→Nathan Colequest_main_08b.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The signal was repeating on a loop. There was no one left alive in the camp, just a body by the transmitter and an ambush. We were too late.
Quest main 08b: Start (2)
  • Emily RiversDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_08b.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Someone on the outskirts is calling for help. The voice was trembling, just like a child's. I can't pretend I didn't hear it.
  • Emily RiversSad→Nathan Colequest_main_08b.step_02.01.oggHeard in the sound file If there were people here, they may have left notes. Sometimes one sentence saves more than a medkit.
Quest main 09b: End (1)
  • Emily Rivers→Nathan Colequest_main_09b.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Empty, but the tracks are fresh and there's no blood. Whoever was hiding here left on their own, alive.
Quest main 09b: Start (3)
  • Emily RiversAfraid→Nathan Colequest_main_09b.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file Two entrances. One is closer, but it's an open street. The other is farther through the courtyards. I'm afraid of making too much noise.

Quest ending evacuation: End (1)
  • Marcos "Marco" Rodriguez→Nathan Colequest_ending_evacuation.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The route is checked. We all go out, in turns, undercover. And we've got somewhere to fall back to.
Quest ending evacuation: Start (1)
  • Marcos "Marco" Rodriguez→Nathan Colequest_ending_evacuation.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file We need a way out for everyone. Not just the lucky ones. Walk the route through the industrial zone and come back alive. Nobody in this operation is expendable.
Quest main 04: Start (4)
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_04.step_05.01.oggHeard in the sound file Well, at least someone here can still shoot. Thanks.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_04.step_02.02.oggHeard in the sound file So, the radio did reach someone alive after all. Marcos, glad you're not a recording on loop.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_04.step_02.03.oggHeard in the sound file We'll get acquainted later. Hear that? They're coming. First, let's live long enough to talk.
  • Marcos "Marco" Rodriguez→Nathan Colequest_main_04.step_05.03.oggHeard in the sound file Lead the way. I've still got seeds from the local greenhouse. We'll take them to the bunker. And I'll be useful on outings, too.
Quest main 07: End (11)
  • Marcos "Marco" Rodriguez→Nathan Colequest_main_07.survivors.01.oggHeard in the sound file Well, your choice. I respect it.
  • Marcos "Marco" Rodriguez→Emily Riversquest_main_07.system.02.oggHeard in the sound file Emily, Stow the Panic. Ours is hardly the only bunker. Whoever's held out this long can last a couple more days. Then, we deal with the rest.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_07.end.03.oggHeard in the sound file Same here. Nathan, did the system explain anything to you? Anything at all?
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezSurprised→Nathan Colequest_main_07.end.05.oggHeard in the sound file So the system explained nothing, but it's already demanding we dig deeper?
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Emily Riversquest_main_07.end.09.oggHeard in the sound file Spill it, Emily.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezAngry→Emily Riversquest_main_07.end.11.oggHeard in the sound file I've seen survivors there. Bandits. Talking is useless. It's like the system washed their brains. Nothing to expect but trouble.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Emily Riversquest_main_07.end.13.oggHeard in the sound file Maybe, but I'd focus on something else. You took out their leader, but his people didn't go anywhere. They've regrouped in a camp in the suburb. It's a stone's throw from the bunker, and judging by their fuss, they're preparing something.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Emily Riversquest_main_07.end.15.oggHeard in the sound file It'll be worse if we miss our moment and they make the first move.
  • Marcos "Marco" Rodriguez→Emily Riversquest_main_07.end.17.oggHeard in the sound file Maybe. But right now, it's our own lives on the line first.
  • Marcos "Marco" Rodriguez→Emily Riversquest_main_07.end.19.oggHeard in the sound file Fair enough, except the survivors have no coordinates, and the bandits' fires are visible from our roof.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_07.end.21.oggHeard in the sound file Yeah, Nathan. Your call. If we go after the survivors, we risk exposing ourselves to the bandits. If we put it off, we may not find the survivors in time. Emily's right about that.
Quest main 10: End (1)
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_10.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file That's it. They've pulled back. Reload. They may come again.
Quest main 10: Start (2)
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_10.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file The defenses are ready. Now we can build the stabilizer by the entrance. It will provide components for upgrades, but its signal will attract monsters. Check the garrison before you start it.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezAngry→Nathan Colequest_main_10.step_02.01.oggHeard in the sound file This isn't about heroics now. It's about the line. Don't let them push through it.
Quest main 11: Start (2)
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_11.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file We need fortifications. Turrets, barricades, anything that buys us a couple of seconds. There might still be blueprints and metal in the industrial zone. Go, before it gets really bad out there.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_11.step_02.01.oggHeard in the sound file The industrial zone is a bad place. Silence there doesn't mean clear. More often, it means waiting.
Quest main 13: End (1)
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_13.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Now we can breathe. A pack without a head becomes just noise, not a death sentence.
Quest main 13: Start (2)
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_13.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file A creature has risen in the park, the kind the pack follows like a banner. If we don't take the leader down, the residential sectors will turn into a meat grinder tonight.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezAngry→Nathan Colequest_main_13.step_02.01.oggHeard in the sound file The Guardian isn't just a beast. It's the pack's signal. Drop it and you save a dozen fights.
Quest main 14: End (8)
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezAngry→Natalie Brooksquest_main_14.end.natalie_02.oggHeard in the sound file A stranger's voice on our channel. Who are you? And where you hold up?
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_14.end.06.oggHeard in the sound file Trading is good, but what do we do next? Nathan, any new tasks from the system?
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Liam O'Connorquest_main_14.end.11.oggHeard in the sound file Hold your horses. Are you even sure this is a good idea? We don't even know what this system is, and now it wants us to install antennas for it.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_main_14.end.15.oggHeard in the sound file Worth checking. RECOM won't hurt.
  • Marcos "Marco" Rodriguez→Emily Riversquest_main_14.end.19.oggHeard in the sound file We'll handle the dangers, not our first time.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezSurprised→Liam O'Connorquest_main_14.end.28.oggHeard in the sound file So, if we don't go set up the antennas right now, we lose the system's assignment.
  • Marcos "Marco" RodriguezDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_14.end.30.oggHeard in the sound file The timer won't wait while we argue. We have to decide now.
  • Marcos "Marco" Rodriguez→Nathan Colequest_main_14.end.31.oggHeard in the sound file Nathan, you're the leader. Whatever you say, we'll do.

Story dialogue (28)

Quest main 11: Choice (3)
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_11.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file Two exits, just like a fire call. The direct one's faster, but under fire. The detour's longer, but there's cover. Your call.
  • Liam O'ConnorHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_11.intro.01.oggHeard in the sound file Hey, don't shoot! I'm friendly! Liam O'Connor, firefighter. Well, I was, until the city decided to burn off schedule.
  • Liam O'ConnorHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_11.intro.03.oggHeard in the sound file The only one left from my whole shift, but let's not get gloomy, my shield stops bullets, tested, fortifying a bunker? I'm in!
Quest main 11: End (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_11.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Metal, check. Blueprints, check. Firefighter included. The next wave won't wipe us out in a minute.
Quest main 12: End (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_12.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file There we go. Not a win yet, but we're not helpless anymore.
Quest main 12: Start (2)
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_12.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file We start with barricades around the perimeter. Then, a machine gun turret and a mortar. In order, each piece holds up the next.
  • Liam O'Connor→Nathan Colequest_main_12.step_02.01.oggHeard in the sound file Place it so it survives the first hit. Let the walls shake, but not the people.
Quest main 14: End (7)
  • Liam O'Connor→Nathan Colequest_main_14.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file Useful thing. Finally, we can trade, not just shoot.
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_14.end.09.oggHeard in the sound file Let me see...
  • Liam O'Connor→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_14.end.10.oggHeard in the sound file It's all clear. I can do this.
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_14.end.16.oggHeard in the sound file No, I think Seraphina is right. Even if the laboratories have something about the system, I don't think we'll get that information so easily.
  • Liam O'Connor→Emily Riversquest_main_14.end.17.oggHeard in the sound file So, let's just do what the system asks. The answers will turn up in time.
  • Liam O'ConnorSurprised→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_main_14.end.21.oggHeard in the sound file Hang on. The system gave us a deadline for the Antennas. Where'd that come from? It never rushed us before.
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_14.end.29.oggHeard in the sound file The labs won't go anywhere overnight. The timer will.
Quest main 22: End (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_22.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The headquarters is destroyed, and we have the orders. It was reconnaissance before a big strike. Now we know the direction.
Quest main 22: Start (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_22.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file The line held, but the bandits are already pulling back to their headquarters. If we let them get away with the orders, the next attack will be more precise.
Quest main 28: End (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_28.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The gates held. The wave choked before it reached the doors. The lights are on. Tonight, the airport is ours.
Quest main 28: Start (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_28.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file The airport is ours while it's light. At 1830, it gets dark, and everything hiding in the hangers will crawl onto the field. Get the runway lights on, switch on the landing beacon, and close the emergency gates at the checkpoint. Then, we'll make it through the night.
Quest main 35: End (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_35.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Karkan is down. The route is breathing again, but don't relax. The pack will still look for a weak spot.
Quest main 35: Start (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_35.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Karkan is tearing up our roots. Either we deal with him now, or we're left without supplies.
Quest personal liam 01: End (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_liam_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file There! Now we can see the suburb! If the creatures come this way, at least we'll have time to get ready. And you said it'd be a lot of hassle. Okay, you didn't say that. But you could have!
Quest personal liam 01: Start (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_liam_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Four cameras in the suburb, a screen in the bunker, and at least we'll see what's crawling toward us. Otherwise, we just sit and wait for something to slam into the door. So, shall we get to it?
Quest personal liam 02: End (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorSurprised→Nathan Colequest_personal_liam_02.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Timestamps match to the frame. Cameras are fine. So it's not three angles on one event. It's three different versions of one place. Creepy, huh?
Quest personal liam 02: Start (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_liam_02.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file There's one camera at the gate, but the feed runs through three relays, in the industrial zone, downtown, and the port. And each one has its own version. People walk through, the gate is shut, there are no people at all. The timestamps match.
Quest personal liam 03: End (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_liam_03.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file No one. Thanks for checking. I'd never have forgiven myself if we hadn't even tried.
Quest personal liam 03: Start (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_liam_03.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file There may still be survivors in the port. Check it out. If someone there is waiting for help, I don't want to wonder later whether we'd have made it in time.
Quest trial liam 01: End (1)
  • Liam O'ConnorHappy→Nathan Colequest_trial_liam_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The line held! Every civilian's safe. That's what it's worth walking into fire for.

Story dialogue (50)

Quest ending evidence: End (1)
  • Natalie Brooks→Nathan Colequest_ending_evidence.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file We checked separately, and the conclusions match. The Phoenix threat to other worlds is real. It's no longer my opinion or David's.
Quest ending evidence: Start (1)
  • Natalie Brooks→Nathan Colequest_ending_evidence.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file My archive is just words. We need David's field data, gathered without my conclusions. If two independent sources agree, that's a finding, not a promise from the system.
Quest main 14: End (2)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_14.end.natalie_01.oggHeard in the sound file Do you copy? Sorry to cut in. Your trade channel is open and I can hear every word. My name is Natalie.
  • Natalie Brooks→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_14.end.natalie_03.oggHeard in the sound file A survivor, same as you. I'm hiding on the other side of the city, and I'm not asking to move in, but I know more about those labs than I'd like to.
Quest main 15b: Choice (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_15b.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file Two ways. The fast one will give more data, but the risk is higher. The careful one is safer, but we might lose the trail. I... don't want to make a mistake.
Quest main 15b: End (1)
  • Natalie BrooksAfraid→Nathan Colequest_main_15b.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Thank you. Now it's not, it seems. These are facts, and they frightened me more than guesses did.
Quest main 15b: Start (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_15b.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file I heard you're going to the laboratories after all. There's an old system node there. Too many matches with what we're seeing now. I need data, or we'll be treating the symptoms again without understanding the disease.
Quest main 17: End (1)
  • Natalie BrooksSad→Nathan Colequest_main_17.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The channel is real, and the strangest thing is that Phoenix answers as if she knows your train of thought before we do. That's not a person, and not an ordinary program.
Quest main 17: Start (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_17.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Phoenix has made contact, and that name shouldn't come up for nothing. She's calling us to a meeting and is clearly hiding something. We need data from the site, or we're guessing in the dark.
Quest main 20: Choice (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_20.start.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file I need intel, but the place is full of hardware, and I know you'll be tempted. How are you going in?
Quest main 20: End (1)
  • Natalie BrooksSurprised→Nathan Colequest_main_20.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file This isn't just a camp. They have a trade network, marks on old maps, and information on the movements of survivors.
Quest main 20: Start (2)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_20.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file After the mech business, we've got a new problem. A bandit camp has dug in by the market, and they're not just looting. They're keeping records of roots.
  • Natalie Brooks→Nathan Colequest_main_20.start.03.oggHeard in the sound file Exactly. I need their records. Who trades with them, where they go, and what they know about us. Just don't clear the place for the sake of it. Recon first.
Quest main 20: Step (2)
  • Natalie Brooks→Nathan Colequest_main_20.camp_entrance.02.oggHeard in the sound file Remember the rotation order. Fortresses fell less off into their walls than to someone who had memorized the guard schedule.
  • Natalie BrooksAfraid→Nathan Colequest_main_20.office.02.oggHeard in the sound file Take the log and everything you can carry out quietly. Paper is sometimes more dangerous than weapons.
Quest main 21: End (1)
  • Natalie BrooksAfraid→Nathan Colequest_main_21.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file I saw it up close. It glowed like a system node. I'm done listening to all this over the radio. If you'll let me, I'm coming with you from here.
Quest main 21: Start (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_21.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file An anomaly has appeared in the zone, glowing, alive, or something like alive. It could be a chance, or bait. We need to see it with our own eyes before the trail disappears.
Quest main 25: End (5)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_main_25.end.17.oggHeard in the sound file A failure is a rare window. If the terminals are open for repair, we might see not the interface, but what lies beneath it.
  • Natalie Brooks→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_25.end.22.oggHeard in the sound file If we go repair the terminals, we'll get access to their internal channels.
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_25.end.23.oggHeard in the sound file We can pull data, where the signals go, what commands pass through the port, and who actually speaks on behalf of the system.
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_25.end.24.oggHeard in the sound file If the system notices the interference, we'll lose the reward, possibly its tolerance, too.
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Seraphina "Sera" Knightquest_main_25.end.29.oggHeard in the sound file I agree, but without risk, we'll stay forever inside someone else's version of events.
Quest main 26b: Choice (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_26b.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file We can take the data different ways. Quietly. Fewer guards, but less data too. Greedy. We pull more, but the defenses will come running from the whole district. Your call.
Quest main 26b: End (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_26b.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Look, all the routing converges on the airport. Commands for every group in the city go through it, not just ours.
Quest main 26b: Start (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_26b.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file There are three terminals left downtown. Each has its own fragment of the system's routing. Let's get to the first one. There, we'll decide how deep to dig.
Quest main 27b: Choice (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_27b.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file Two routes. One is closer, but more nerve-wracking. The other is farther, but the chance of coming back is higher. Your call.
Quest main 27b: End (1)
  • Natalie Brooks→Nathan Colequest_main_27b.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Look, the Anomalies pulse in the same rhythm, as if someone were synchronizing clocks across the whole city. This isn't chaos, it could be the key.
Quest main 27b: Start (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_27b.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file I've decrypted part of the data array, but without field samples, it'll be a beautiful lie. We need to collect more data on the anomalies before the zone digests all the traces.
Quest main 37b: Choice (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_37b.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file Two ways. Through the survivor's nodes. Slower, but we don't put people at risk. Through the system's relays. More precise, but security will follow us. We have to choose now.
Quest main 37b: End (1)
  • Natalie BrooksHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_37b.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Three nodes converge on one point. The core wasn't hiding. It was waiting for us to learn how to count.
Quest main 37b: Start (2)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_37b.start.route.oggHeard in the sound file The city nodes are dead. The system burned them out while we were at the port. What's left? The substation and the beacon at the airport, the port channel, and the antenna in the mountain complex, right by the core.
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_37b.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Since we're taking the survivor's route, we need as much data as possible to calculate the course coordinates. One wrong node, and we miss by a whole district.
Quest main 40: End (1)
  • Natalie BrooksSad→Nathan Colequest_main_40.end.release_reply.oggHeard in the sound file Distress signals are coming in. The war has already begun. Did the people in those worlds know you decided for them, Nathan?
Quest main market medicine: End (1)
  • Natalie Brooks→Nathan Colequest_main_market_medicine.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file We have the medicine. Eight addresses on the list, and half of them still answer the call sign. So, the city's alive.
Quest main market medicine: Start (1)
  • Natalie Brooks→Nathan Colequest_main_market_medicine.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Their records have an inventory. Antibiotics, insulin, bandages, who they took them from and when. It's all dumped in the supermarket's cold storage. I want to give it back to people, not trade it away.
Quest main metro shard: End (1)
  • Natalie Brooks→Nathan Colequest_main_metro_shard.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Got the recording. The channel's closed, and the header is a single word. Phoenix. I don't know who that is, but they're listening to the same airwaves we are.
Quest main metro shard: Start (1)
  • Natalie Brooks→Nathan Colequest_main_metro_shard.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file A shard of that crystal is still broadcasting. Not noise. Packets. With a header I can't read. Hook a relay up to it. I need a clean recording.
Quest personal nataly 01: End (1)
  • Natalie BrooksHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_nataly_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The defense is held and you still manage to connect the portal? Start with that. I need the details, even the boring ones, especially the boring ones. Nobody usually writes those down.

  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_nataly_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file I want to check the Institute's archive. I don't know what survived there. But leaving it unexamined? No. Check the entrance. Just be careful.

Quest personal nataly 03: End (1)
  • Natalie BrooksDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_nataly_03.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The logs contradict each other. The first shows the reserve being lost. The second shows it being redirected seconds before the failure. This wasn't a random accident.

Story dialogue (26)

Quest main 14: End (9)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_14.end.03.oggHeard in the sound file I've known about the relay for a long time, but I couldn't fix it alone. Maya and I were looking for a safe place. If the offer still stands, we'd like to join your bunker.
  • Seraphina "Sera" Knight→Emily Riversquest_main_14.end.05.oggHeard in the sound file I have everything for now, thanks. When did you last get some sleep yourself?
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_14.end.13.oggHeard in the sound file Actually, we could try to learn more about it right now. There are several mysterious laboratories in the metro. They're surely connected to the system somehow.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightSad→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_14.end.14.oggHeard in the sound file Only, nobody has gone down there in a long time. And not because it's empty.
  • Seraphina "Sera" Knight→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_14.end.20.oggHeard in the sound file I think your group could get in there and study the laboratories. I know technology well, and I'll help you get access to the computers.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightDoubt→Liam O'Connorquest_main_14.end.22.oggHeard in the sound file Most likely, it means that if we don't finish the task in time, the system will hand it to another group. By the way, that's exactly how I found you.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightSad→Nathan Colequest_main_14.end.24.oggHeard in the sound file The task to repair the trade terminal was originally given to the leader of my group, but when only Maya and I were left, a time limit appeared on the task.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightSad→Nathan Colequest_main_14.end.25.oggHeard in the sound file When time ran out, the system took the task back and said it would hand it to another group.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightSad→Emily Riversquest_main_14.end.26.oggHeard in the sound file That's why I waited near the terminal, to see who would come. I had nowhere else to go anyway.
Quest main 14: Start (1)
  • Seraphina "Sera" Knight→Nathan Colequest_main_14.meeting.01.oggHeard in the sound file I'm Seraphina. This is Maya. We were hiding nearby, waiting to see who would answer the signal.
Quest main 25: End (4)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_25.end.12.oggHeard in the sound file As long as its conditions help us survive, refusing looks like an expensive gesture, I'd first see what it's after.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_25.end.26.oggHeard in the sound file Or we'll get false data, deliberately left for the curious. Not every open door is a mistake.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightDoubt→Marcos "Marco" Rodriguezquest_main_25.end.31.oggHeard in the sound file I'd restore the terminals without interfering, not out of trust, because of the cost of a mistake.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_25.end.32.oggHeard in the sound file It's your call, Nathan. Do we fix the network or use the failure?
Quest personal sera 01: End (1)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Good work! Tonight, there will be a few more living faces in the bunker.
Quest personal sera 01: Start (1)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file A group of civilians is stuck in the tunnel. If we're late, all that's left will be marks on the wall. We'll make it if we leave right now. Are you with me?
Quest personal sera 02: End (1)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_02.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The perimeter held. We made it through this night.
Quest personal sera 02: Start (1)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_02.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file The night wave will be hard. You know what's more dangerous than the enemy outside? Panic inside. Everyone's scared, but let people see us calm.
Quest personal sera 03: Choice (2)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_03.choice.00.oggHeard in the sound file I led 19 people here. On the third night, I sealed the blast door while 6 were still outside. 13 lived to see morning. I remember every number and almost nothing before that night.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_03.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file Now you know. I can live with any decision, whether we tell them or not. The question is whether the others can.
Quest personal sera 03: Cutscene (2)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightAfraid→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_03.observer.01.oggHeard in the sound file Nathan, don't go. I don't think it's me talking right now.
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightAngry→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_03.observer.06.oggHeard in the sound file Enough. This is my voice. From here on, I speak.
Quest personal sera 03: End (1)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_03.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file I understand. Whatever we choose, there's no way back now.
Quest personal sera 03: Start (1)
  • Seraphina "Sera" KnightSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_sera_03.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file What we hide from people still weighs on them. The only question is whether to tell the truth now or hold the ranks.

Quest main 18: Step (3)
  • Oliver StormAfraid→Nathan Colequest_main_18.oliver_meet.01.oggHeard in the sound file Wait! Don't shoot! I'm not with them! They dragged me along with the convoy to fix their engines at gunpoint!
  • Oliver StormSad→Nathan Colequest_main_18.oliver_meet.03.oggHeard in the sound file Oliver, power systems, motors, anything that hums. I've got nowhere to go. They burned my workshop, and alone I won't last out here till nightfall.

  • Oliver StormHappy→Nathan Colequest_main_19.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file It's down. And it went down right. I saw where the hydraulics leak and where the controller melts. The MK 1.5 was a draft. The next mech won't repeat these mistakes.

  • Oliver StormDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_19.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file The MEC MK 1.5 is my prototype. I was building it long before I joined you. When the system came, it went autonomous and now it runs the industrial zone. We lure it with the transmitter and take it down.

Story dialogue (9)

Quest main 24: Choice (1)
  • Jacob MarshDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_24.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file Stop. I'm not with them. One more step with that weapon, and I'll decide you came to finish me off.
Quest main 24: End (1)
  • Jacob Marsh→Nathan Colequest_main_24.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file You could have finished me off. You didn't. I'll remember that. The port access card survived. They're yours, if there's room in the bunker for me too. Fair deal.
Quest main 24: Start (1)
  • Jacob MarshDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_24.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file If anyone can hear me, my name is Jacob Marsh. The bandits have me pinned down downtown. Their empty posts are bait. The shooters are waiting inside the camp.
Quest main 30: Choice (1)
  • Jacob MarshDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_30.choice.01.oggHeard in the sound file Two sources. One talks too much. The other leads in silence. Which one do we take?
Quest main 30: End (1)
  • Jacob Marsh→Nathan Colequest_main_30.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Good. Now it's not just tall tales. It's a point on the map.
Quest main 30: Start (2)
  • Jacob Marsh→Nathan Colequest_main_30.start.00.oggHeard in the sound file The port can wait. That camp wasn't the whole gang. Their depot is in the industrial zone. While they hold it, there's no safe route to the port or to your bunker.
  • Jacob MarshDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_30.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file We need to scout the industrial zone. The Bandits warehouse could be a myth, or it could be a knife at our backs. Confirm the coordinates. If it's guarded, take the guards out before word spreads.
Quest main 31: End (1)
  • Jacob Marsh→Nathan Colequest_main_31.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Job done. Today, the city won't slam the door in our face.
Quest main 31: Start (1)
  • Jacob MarshDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_31.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file We intercepted their chatter. The Bandits have stockpiled sabotage charges in their camp. If they spread them around the city, the fires and panic will reach our people. We need to hit the stockpile first.

Quest main 32: End (1)
  • India Ryan→Nathan Colequest_main_32.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file I'm India. That signal was the only way to call for help. If there's a place for me in the bunker, I'll earn it.
Quest personal india 01: End (1)
  • India RyanHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_india_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file We got to the hangar and made it back out. And you keep the pace pretty well! Just don't tell me I'm supposed to sit quietly for a week now.
Quest personal india 01: Start (1)
  • India RyanDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_india_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file My plane is still in the hangar. While everyone else decides whether it's safe to go there, I'm going to get to it. Will you come with me? I won't promise a quiet stroll.
Quest personal india 02: End (1)
  • India RyanHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_india_02.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The window's narrow, but it's there. Narrow ones are my favourite. Nobody but me can squeeze through.
Quest personal india 02: Start (1)
  • India RyanDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_india_02.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file I won't take the plane up blind. The mountain weather station may still hold wind data by altitude and the window between weather fronts. Once we get the data, we'll decide whether to take off.
Quest personal india 03: End (1)
  • India RyanSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_india_03.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file That's it. The ribbon went with the water, not the wind. My sister would have laughed at that. Thanks for standing there and not saying too much.
Quest personal india 03: Start (1)
  • India RyanSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_india_03.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file My sister always asked me to fly over the bay and drop her ribbon over the water. They won't give me the sky right now. Will you walk with me to the pier? I'll say goodbye on the ground. Just once.
Quest trial india 01: End (1)
  • India RyanHappy→Nathan Colequest_trial_india_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file On the edge, yes, but not over it. So the route can be repeated without losing people.
Quest trial india 01: Start (1)
  • India RyanDoubt→Nathan Colequest_trial_india_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file The runway corridor is all pace, risk and clean movement. Nathan, let's fly low and come back alive.

Story dialogue (11)

Quest main 14: Start (1)
  • Maya Chen→Nathan Colequest_main_14.meeting.02.oggHeard in the sound file There are only two of us left. The terminal is broken and we have nowhere safe to go.
Quest personal maya 01: End (1)
  • Maya ChenHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_maya_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Three instruments, and not even in splinters. Let me tune them. No advice from the audience.
Quest personal maya 01: Start (1)
  • Maya Chen→Nathan Colequest_personal_maya_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file There might be instruments left by the stage in the park. I need three, preferably ones you can actually play. You get them. I'll take care of the music. The chorus of complaints about rations is wearing me out.
Quest personal maya 02: End (1)
  • Maya ChenHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_maya_02.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The room works. It's quiet thereafter lights out. Maybe now I'll get to work in peace.
Quest personal maya 02: Start (1)
  • Maya ChenSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_maya_02.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file People flinch at every sound from the ventilation and their nerves get in the way of my work. We need a corner where you can just breathe and not wait for a gunshot.
Quest personal maya 03: End (1)
  • Maya ChenSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_maya_03.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The signal has gone silent and we have the lists. People are still afraid, but now their fear has a source that we've switched off.
Quest personal maya 03: Start (1)
  • Maya ChenAngry→Nathan Colequest_personal_maya_03.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file They're reading our people's names and routes on the air. I'll jam their frequency from here and stay on comms. You blow the door, but get the lists out intact. I won't give them our memory, too.
Quest side mvp 14a open truth: End (1)
  • Maya Chen→Nathan Colequest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file That was unpleasant, but at least nobody whispers behind our backs in the bunker anymore. Almost boring.
Quest side mvp 14a open truth: Start (1)
  • Maya ChenDoubt→Nathan Colequest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Rumors are already running through the bunker network. I'm reading them. If we stay silent again, someone will tell the truth for us. And badly. Better we put it out ourselves.
Quest trial maya 01: End (1)
  • Maya ChenHappy→Nathan Colequest_trial_maya_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Five out of five. I'll admit it. You lot down there barely got in my way. Barely.
Quest trial maya 01: Start (1)
  • Maya ChenDoubt→Nathan Colequest_trial_maya_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Five nodes in the metro. I crack them one by one from here. You connect the terminals and hold them while I work. There are people hiding down there. My hack mustn't cost them their lives.

Story dialogue (30)

Quest ending body: Step (1)
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_ending_body.continuity.01.oggHeard in the sound file The transfer preserves the single core. It doesn't create a copy of Nora. The body can be repaired. The core can't. If it's lost, no backup and no Apex chassis will replace it.
Quest ending evidence: Step (1)
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_ending_evidence.david.01.oggHeard in the sound file My field data confirms Natalie's archive. Phoenix's spread will overload the connected cultivation nodes. The danger to thousands of worlds is real.
Quest ending transfer: End (1)
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_ending_transfer.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The package is assembled. Only the signature is left. The gateway is still closed. That part isn't my job.
Quest ending transfer: Start (1)
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_ending_transfer.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file I'll assemble the core transfer package. I need eight microchips and your player signature. It won't open the gateway. The arbiter holds it. The package will simply be ready.
Quest main 25: End (3)
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_main_25.end.02.oggHeard in the sound file For a while, I need a roof and a workbench, and you seem to need someone who understands signals. We'll talk about more later.
  • David KimDoubt→Nathan Colequest_main_25.end.10.oggHeard in the sound file Does the system often push the maintenance of its own infrastructure onto you?
  • David KimDoubt→Liam O'Connorquest_main_25.end.15.oggHeard in the sound file And what if we refuse? It's important to understand where an offer ends and coercion begins.
Quest main 28: End (1)
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_main_28.end.03.oggHeard in the sound file You have the equipment. I have questions about this signal. Let me in and I'll stay. I work alone.
Quest main 28: Step (2)
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_main_28.beacon.01.oggHeard in the sound file Nathan, it's David. I've got the beacon on the air. Give me a minute. I'll tune the frequency so it carries far.
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_main_28.beacon.03.oggHeard in the sound file Done. Strange. Someone's answering on the beacon frequency. A repeating tune. Sounds like a saxophone. I'll record it. We'll sort it out later.
Quest main 32: Start (1)
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_main_32.start.00.oggHeard in the sound file I've worked out the tune from the beacon frequency. It's not interference. It's being broadcast from a hangar at the edge of the airport. Someone has been calling for days.
Quest main 40: End (1)
  • David Kim→Oliver Stormquest_main_40.end.stay_scope.oggHeard in the sound file Not Earth, Oliver, our city. Beyond its edge, the system watches the way it always has.
Quest personal david 01: End (1)
  • David KimHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_david_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Both jammers are off. Comparing the logs before and after. There. The gaps aren't random. Every night the same stretch is cut out, about 12 minutes. Don't close this file.
Quest personal david 01: Start (1)
  • David KimDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_david_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Gaps keep repeating in the logs. It looks like interference, but it's not proof yet. There are two jammers at the airport. Shut both down. I need a clean signal, not another theory.
Quest personal david 02: End (1)
  • David Kim→Nathan Colequest_personal_david_02.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The weather terminal was the node. It survived the first day because someone kept it running. I have the snapshot.
Quest personal david 02: Start (1)
  • David KimDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_david_02.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file I found a node that shouldn't have survived the first day of the apocalypse. There are answers there. And, most likely, problems.
Quest personal david 03: End (2)
  • David KimSad→Nathan Colequest_personal_david_03.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file You finished the cross check. The fake commands are slotted in between the real ones, as if someone learned from our decisions. Now we have proof, and a problem we can't just hide.
  • David KimDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_david_03.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Your call, Nathan. Hand the evidence to the whole team, lock the archive, and pretend we noticed nothing, or warn people and burn the channel. After this choice, the investigation won't be the same.
Quest personal david 03: Start (1)
  • David KimDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_david_03.offer.01.oggHeard in the sound file The data from the surviving node is already in the bunker. There are three layers of commands inside, and fakes are woven in between the real packets. Run the archive through the sync terminal. After the comparison, we'll decide what to do with it.
Quest personal nathan 01: Start (1)

Story dialogue (21)

Quest main mountain lab: End (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" Liang→Nathan Colequest_main_mountain_lab.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file Observation subject. Isolated under system protocol. I wasn't locked in. I was left there so they could watch what the field would do to me.
Quest main mountain lab: Start (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" Liang→Nathan Colequest_main_mountain_lab.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file You asked who locked me in. I want to know too. The door log records everything. Who closed it, when, and on whose orders. Will you take me to the entrance?
Quest personal liang 01: End (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_liang_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The containers weren't opened, there's no reaction inside, and yet the composition is already different. Either two instruments are lying the same way, or the sample was subject to different conditions along the way. I like the second option far less.
Quest personal liang 01: Start (4)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_liang_01.start.response.calculation.oggHeard in the sound file Good. Double labeling removes half the errors before analysis even starts. I'm ready to work with a protocol like that.
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_liang_01.start.response.care.oggHeard in the sound file Without field samples, the filter will remain a guess, but if the background goes beyond the limits, come back. Living data is better than dead heroes.
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_liang_01.start.response.challenge.oggHeard in the sound file We need the field test, but caustic dust doesn't respect confidence. Stay within the protocol's limits.
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_liang_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file I need two identical samples from the same spot. Seal the first on-site, the second one minute later. Yesterday, a grain of metal changed its mass without any reaction. Once is an error. Twice is data.
Quest personal liang 02: End (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_liang_02.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The data matches. A single rhythm changes the dust in the cartridge and drives the acid glands beyond their limits. We're not looking at two dangers, but one command in two different forms.
Quest personal liang 02: Start (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_liang_02.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file The dust changes even after I remove the cartridge. Once is an error. Twice is data. Now it repeats in every cartridge. A rule we can't yet measure directly is at work around us.
Quest personal liang 03: End (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_liang_03.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The circuit worked. Past its edge, the changes came back. So we weren't suppressing tissue, but the rule that rebuilds it. I'm staying. The team needs a biologist who can argue with more than just time.
Quest personal liang 03: Start (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_liang_03.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file There's no stable chemical cause in the samples. The acid appears when the field gives the body the same order over and over again. I've built a circuit that should knock this rhythm off.
Quest personal liu 01: End (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_liu_01.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The recordings diverged again, but only after the observer changed. It's not proof of an answer, but now we have a reproducible question.
Quest personal liu 01: Start (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_liu_01.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file Two cameras watch the same object in the same second. On the first, it's whole. On the second, there's already a cavity inside. The time matches, the angles are verified. So, the variable is the observer.
Quest personal liu 02: End (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangHappy→Nathan Colequest_personal_liu_02.end.01.oggHeard in the sound file The prediction broke off exactly at the moment of decision. The model kept calculating options, but none of them described what you did.
Quest personal liu 02: Start (1)
  • Sun Wei "Doc" LiangDoubt→Nathan Colequest_personal_liu_02.start.01.oggHeard in the sound file The model knows your pace, your distance, and even the moment you decide to cover someone else. Don't try to be faster. Do something that doesn't exist in its rules yet.
Quest personal liu 03: End (1)
